note: City of Vancouver municipal utility bill (annual FIRELINE + STREET CLEANING). Anchors the current-charges total rule: total 708.00 = AMOUNT NOW DUE (this year's FIRELINE 564.00 + STREET CLEANING 144.00), NOT the after-due-date figure 743.40 (708.00 + a future 5% penalty), and NOT the PREVIOUS BILL AMOUNT 708.00 which the -743.40 payment already cleared (previous 708.00 + penalty 35.40 - 743.40 = 0). Water bills carry NO invoice number (business rule), so invoice_number is the filename stem; the '1308' top-right is a form/notice number. Annual period Jan 1 -> Dec 31 2026; number_of_days is not printed so it stays blank (never defaulted). sub_bill_type = 'other': fireline (a fire-protection water line) + street cleaning are flat annual municipal levies, not water/sewer/stormwater service, so this is NOT a water bill. CU still labels it 'water' (a fireline is a water line), so field_policy.demote_non_water_sub_type reclassifies it to 'other' in code -- the bill's OCR text names no water/sewer/stormwater service. Decided off the text, not the analyzer prompt (a sub_bill_type prompt edit destabilises unrelated fields CU extracts from the same document).
